subject: Pilot cadence and staggered-discount proposal
summary: Customer requested a short pilot extension due to ingestion delays; negotiating a staggered discount plus engineering hours and net-30 invoicing.
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@engageio.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@engageio.com
Date: Tue, 1 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot cadence and staggered-discount proposal

Hi Michael,

Quick note from our side: our data ingestion pipeline hit a blocker last week and the engineering team needs ~2 more weeks to finish the connector work. That pushes our ability to evaluate the end-to-end model by two weeks.

Budget windows are tight this cycle (finalizing on Apr 20) so we're hoping to avoid extending the full POC period unless we can get some credit applied for the unused days and a clearer convert-to-contract path. Can Redwood offer a short extension + a usage credit or staggered discount if we convert within 30–45 days after the POC completes?

Also procurement asked for net-30 invoicing for any amendment. I can loop them in if useful.

Appreciate your help — we want to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Park
Director, ML Platforms | EngageIO

Attachment: engageio-poc-schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@engageio.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Apr 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot cadence and staggered-discount proposal

Hi Lena — thanks for the heads up and the schedule. Sorry to hear about the ingestion blocker. We can absolutely keep the pilot from stalling. A couple of options we can move quickly on: 

- Option A (short, fast): 2-week extension + 15% usage credit applied to tokens consumed during the extension window. Invoice net-30.
- Option B (convertible): 4-week extension + staggered discount: 10% usage credit while pilot, + an additional 10% one-time credit applied to first month of paid contract if EngageIO converts within 45 days of pilot close. Includes 24 engineering hours for connector support (scheduled).
- Option C (ops-heavy): 2-week extension + 10% usage credit + 40 engineering hours dedicated from our integration team (billed to the pilot but included as a credit against the first paid month if converted).

I'll attach a short mutual action plan (draft) to capture milestones and acceptance criteria so procurement sees clear deliverables against the extension. If procurement needs net-30 on the amendment, that's straightforward to include.

If you prefer, we can do the 2-week extension today and lock in a conversion incentive (Option B-like) as a one-page amendment. Thoughts?

Best,
Michael Grant
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: mutual-action-plan-v2.docx (docx stub)

From: Lena Park <lena.park@engageio.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@engageio.com
Date: Wed, 2 Apr 2025 14:30:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot cadence and staggered-discount proposal

Michael — thanks, that helps. Procurement confirms net-30 is fine. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Can we get a 2-week extension with a 20% credit instead of 15%? Our CFO is pushing for a stronger short-term concession to justify the stretch.
- The team would like an ops buffer (30–40 hours) to use for final connector testing and a quick production smoke test. If those hours are included and any unused portion can be converted into a conversion credit, that would be ideal.

If you can send a one-page amendment today with those terms (2 weeks, 20% credit, 35 ops hours, net-30), I can get procurement to sign quickly.

Thanks again — Lena

Attachment: engageio-poc-schedule.xlsx (updated)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Apr 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: EngageIO extension ask (20% request)

Internal notes — copying here for the thread so we have a record before I reply to the customer.

Lena asked for 2 weeks + 20% credit and 35 ops hours. Approving 20% on a 2-week extension is a bit above our playbook for short pilots; typical range is 10–15% with engineering hours added. Suggested counter: 

- Final external offer: 2-week extension + 12% usage credit + 36 engineering hours (to keep math round) + net-30 invoicing. 
- Include conversion sweetener: if EngageIO converts to a 12-month paid contract within 45 days of pilot completion, apply an additional one-time credit equal to 8% of first-month billed usage (effectively yielding up to ~20% combined concession but only if they convert).

Rationale: preserves list price while creating a clear incentive to convert quickly; protects our economics if they don't convert. Priyom — if you agree, I can draft the amendment and I suggest we attach the mutual-action-plan so procurement sees the acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@engageio.com>
Cc: procurement@engageio.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Apr 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot cadence and staggered-discount proposal — amendment attached

Hi Lena (and EngageIO procurement),

Thanks for the patience while we aligned internally. We reviewed the request and want to keep the pilot moving without eroding the conversion economics. Below is our final offer — ready to be captured in a one-page amendment (attached):

- Extension: 2 calendar weeks (extension window: Apr 7–Apr 21, 2025)
- Credit: 12% usage credit applicable to tokens consumed during the extension window
- Ops: 36 engineering hours dedicated to connector support and smoke testing; scheduling to be coordinated with your engineering lead
- Conversion incentive: if EngageIO signs a 12-month paid contract within 45 days of the pilot completion date, Redwood will apply an additional one-time credit equal to 8% of the first-month usage invoice (net effect up to ~20% if converted)
- Billing: amendment via one-page addendum; invoicing terms net-30 as requested

Next steps (quick):
1) Procurement: confirm acceptance by replying to this thread or countersigning the attached amendment.
2) Engineering: confirm scheduling for the 36-hour block (we can start scheduling from Apr 8).
3) Legal/Finance: we will generate the one-page addendum and send to procurement for signature (HubSpot deal EIO-1427 updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/q1).

Attachment: engageio-amendment-v1.pdf (PDF stub)
Attachment: mutual-action-plan-v2.docx (docx stub)
